title: Applications for Open Source Microplate-Compatible Illumination Panels
protocol: Generate a CSV file containing source and destination plates.
Include header columns in the order: Source_barcode; Destination_barcode; Source_well; Dest_well; Transfer_volume.
Enter one row for each desired pipetting operation with specific information under the header columns.
Open the Microplate Assistive Pipetting Light Emitter Plate to plate GUI application.
Click the Select cherrypick file button.
Navigate to the CSV file generated in steps 1.1 and 1.2 using the file browser window.
Click the Open button.
The application will parse the first row of the CSV file and illuminate corresponding wells in the source and destination plates.
Use the Previous well button to traverse the CSV file backwards.
Use the Next well button to traverse the CSV file forwards.
Highlight grey any rows that have been previously illuminated.
Highlight brown the currently active row.
Perform pipetting operations as needed to transfer samples between source well of source plate to destination well of destination plate.
Continue until the end of the CSV file is reached via the Next well button.
To load a new CSV file, click the Select cherrypick file button at any time.
Exit the program by clicking the red X at the top right corner of the GUI.
Open the Microplate Assistive Pipetting Light Emitter 'Serial dilution' application by opening Maple-SerialDilution.exe.
Use the GUI to specify the desired titration mode (column or row).
Specify plate density and start row(s) or column(s) using the GUI.
Specify a column or row mask if needed to control LED illumination.
Step through rows or columns in sequence from the initial start position to the last position using Next and Previous buttons.
Click the red X at the top right corner of the GUI to exit the program.
Place a 96- or 384-well microplate into the portable light guide.
Power on the portable light guide system using the power toggle switch.
Determine the mode for the portable light guide.
Load the portable light guide into the default HTS demo mode.
Use the right pushbutton switch to toggle through sample illumination patterns in HTS demo mode.
Toggle the light guide between HTS demo mode and Titration demo mode using the left pushbutton switch.
Enter the Titration demo mode when the left pushbutton is pressed.
In Titration demo mode, all wells in column 3 and column 13 are illuminated with yellow color initially.
Subsequent presses of the rightmost pushbutton switch illuminate columns sequentially (e.g., columns 4 and 14, then columns 5 and 15, etc.).
Place a 96- or 384-well microplate into the portable light guide.
Switch the light guide to Illumination mode by pressing the leftmost pushbutton switch two times.
Toggle between a set of predefined colors using the right pushbutton as needed for the application.
